title: TV Clock Now Shows 24 Hours Back, 5 Hours Ahead | vitalii.no
description:
The kitchen TV kiosk clock only ever showed the current sugar reading and the current weather — a snapshot of right now, with no sense of whether sugar was climbing or weather was about to change. For a child with type 1 diabetes, those are exactly the two things you want to plan around, and a single number can't show a trend.

I restructured the kiosk's weather cell into today's icon and temperature stacked over a new row of up to 5 hourly cells, and the sugar cell into the current value and trend arrow stacked over a new SVG chart drawing the last 24 hours as a line inside the safe corridor. Both the weather icons and the chart repaint instantly with the clock's existing day/night colour and the alert flash, with no separate colour logic to maintain.

Instead of only knowing the sugar value right now, anyone glancing at the kiosk can see the last 24 hours' shape and the next 5 hours' weather, both at a glance from across the room.
